howTo: Upload the file to the root folder of your Minecraft Java server and restart the server.
faqs: What size should a Minecraft server icon be?
A Java server icon should be 64x64 pixels and saved as a PNG file named server-icon.png.
Upload it to the main/root folder of your server, usually the same place as server.properties.
Why is my server icon not showing?
Check that the file is named exactly server-icon.png, is PNG format, is 64x64, and that the server has been restarted.
